title: Online Color Picker & Converter — Hex, RGB, HSL Made Easy

content.intro: Every designer and frontend developer needs a reliable color picker. Craftisle's free tool combines an interactive color wheel, format conversion, palette generation, and accessibility checks — all in one place.

sections.heading: Color Formats Decoded
sections.body: HEX: #FF6B35 — the web standard, easy to copy-paste. RGB: rgb(255, 107, 53) — used in CSS and design tools. HSL: hsl(16, 100%, 60%) — most intuitive for humans (Hue/Saturation/Lightness). Our converter instantly translates between all three.

sections.heading: Creating Color Palettes
sections.body: Complementary: colors opposite on the wheel (high contrast). Analogous: adjacent colors (harmonious). Triadic: three equally spaced colors (vibrant). Monochromatic: variations of one hue (elegant). Our palette generator creates all of these from a single base color.

sections.heading: Color Accessibility (WCAG)
sections.body: WCAG 2.1 AA requires a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1 for normal text and 3:1 for large text. Our picker shows the contrast ratio in real-time and flags non-compliant combinations. About 8% of men have some form of color blindness — avoid relying solely on red/green distinctions.

sections.heading: How to Use the Color Picker
sections.body: Pick from the wheel, enter a hex code, or use the eyedropper. Adjust hue, saturation, and lightness with sliders. Copy any format: HEX, RGB, HSL, or CSS variable. Generate a palette with one click. Check contrast against a text background.

content.conclusion: Color is one of the most powerful tools in design. Whether you're matching brand colors, building a design system, or just need a hex code, Craftisle's Color Picker makes it fast and enjoyable.
